check-missing-application-documents.reason: Missing-document detection is one status in a submission checklist.

compare-material-requirements.reason: Requirement extraction already produces normalized material constraints that can be compared in conversation.

compare-opportunity-targets.reason: Both compare verified opportunities against user criteria and evidence.

compare-roles-or-directions.reason: Direction comparison is the ranking step performed while narrowing candidates.

draft-email-out-of-cover-letter.reason: Compressing a completed letter into an email is a lightweight conversational rewrite, not a separate workflow capability.

draft-informational-interview-outreach.reason: Informational outreach is a contact-message intent.

draft-outreach-message.reason: Requirement clarification outreach is a contact-message intent.

evidence-gap-plan.reason: Both map verified user evidence to opportunity requirements and identify gaps.

info-conversation-prep.reason: Both create grounded goals and questions for an information conversation.

list-unverified-facts-for-supplement.reason: Unverified facts are already an output class of application fact checking.

material-prep-planning.reason: Material preparation priority follows opportunity priority and can be scheduled by the weekly checklist.

outreach-lead-comparison.reason: Lead comparison exists to produce a contact order, which sequencing already returns.

prepare-informational-questions.reason: Clarifying questions are a specialized informational-interview question set.

prepare-project-showcase-sheet.reason: The core evidence-bound project rewrite is retained; one-page formatting can be handled in normal conversation.

preview-likely-evaluation-questions.reason: Likely questions are a lightweight derivative of entry requirements and evidence gaps.

response-digest-synthesis.reason: Both turn application responses into prioritized next actions.

role-context-brief.reason: Role context, daily work, deliverables, and collaboration evidence substantially overlap.

translate-application-material.reason: Translation is a general model capability and does not justify a dedicated deferred Tool.

build-submission-checklist.search_hint: check missing application documents and build a final submission checklist from requirements and prepared materials

compare-profile-with-requirements.search_hint: compare verified user evidence with role requirements, identify evidence gaps, and list facts that still need confirmation

draft-contact-message.search_hint: draft a restrained contact message for networking, informational interviews, referrals, or application requirement clarification

followup-prioritization.search_hint: digest application responses and prioritize who to follow up with and what to do next

narrow-directions-to-validate.search_hint: compare, narrow, and rank candidate career directions for validation using user evidence and constraints

prepare-informational-interviews.search_hint: prepare grounded goals and questions for an informational interview or role conversation

rank-opportunities-to-pursue.search_hint: compare and rank verified job opportunities and decide where application preparation effort should go first

rewrite-project-accounts-for-opportunity.search_hint: rewrite verified project experience for a target opportunity or project showcase while preserving factual boundaries

understand-real-work.search_hint: research role context, daily work, deliverables, collaborators, and team environment from public evidence
